``` {r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Global Configuration & Environment
# ==============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

# Options configuration: Sum-to-zero contrasts for valid Type III ANOVA results 
# and valid zero-correlation parameterizations.
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global Settings & Analysis Targets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
experiment_version <- "E2"  # Options: "E1" or "E2"

# Component definitions. Format: c("Component_Name" = Include_Covariate_Boolean)
# Synchronized with preprocessing output (N170, FRN, P2, N400, LPP_offer).
analyze_stim_components <- c(
  "N170"      = TRUE,
  "FRN"       = TRUE,
  "P2"        = TRUE,
  "N400"      = TRUE,
  "LPP_offer" = TRUE
)

analyze_resp_components <- c(
  "CPP"       = FALSE
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, readr, readxl, dplyr, tidyr, stringr,  # Data Wrangling
  lme4, lmerTest,                              # Modeling
  car, parameters, performance,                # Diagnostics & APA Extraction
  buildmer,                                    # Random Structure Optimization
  emmeans, effectsize,                         # Statistical Inference
  sjPlot, sjmisc,                              # Quick Visualization
  ggplot2, ggpubr, gridExtra,                  # Publication Visualization
  openxlsx                                     # Excel Reporting
)

# Configuration: Force calculation of Denominator DF
emmeans::emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 50000, pbkrtest.limit = 50000)

# Path definition: Dynamic Output Directory
out_root <- here("results", "EEG", paste0(experiment_version, "_Stats_Regression_Method"))
if(!dir.exists(out_root)) dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Initializing pipeline for Experiment: %s\nOutput Directory: %s\n", 
            experiment_version, out_root))

# Visual Theme & Palettes
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))

colors_emo <- c('neu'="#8491B4",'aff'="#91D1C2",'dis'="#E64B35",'dom'="#F39B7F",'enj'="#3C5488")
labels_emo <- c('neu'='Neutral','aff'='Affiliative','dis'='Disgust','dom'='Dominance','enj'='Reward')
colors_off <- c('fair'="#2E86AB",'unfair'="#A23B72")
labels_off <- c('fair'='Fair', 'unfair'='Unfair')

custom_control <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000), calc.derivs = FALSE)


```

``` {r apa-module}
# ==============================================================================
# Helper Function: Format ANOVA F-Table to APA String
# ==============================================================================
format_anova_apa <- function(anova_obj) {
  df_res <- as.data.frame(anova_obj) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect")
  
  es_df <- data.frame(Parameter = character(), Eta2_partial = numeric())
  tryCatch({
    es <- effectsize::eta_squared(anova_obj, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95, verbose = FALSE)
    es_df <- as.data.frame(es) %>% select(Parameter, Eta2_partial)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(nrow(es_df) > 0) {
    df_res <- left_join(df_res, es_df, by = c("Effect" = "Parameter"))
  } else {
    df_res$Eta2_partial <- NA
  }
  
  get_col <- function(col_name) if(col_name %in% names(df_res)) df_res[[col_name]] else NA
  
  df_res <- df_res %>%
    mutate(
      F_val  = get_col("F value"), NumDF  = get_col("NumDF"),
      DenDF  = get_col("DenDF"),   p_val  = get_col("Pr(>F)"),
      p_str = case_when(
        is.na(p_val) ~ "-",
        p_val < .001 ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
      ),
      Eta_str = ifelse(is.na(Eta2_partial), "-", sprintf("%.2f", Eta2_partial)),
      APA_Report = case_when(
        !is.na(F_val) & !is.na(NumDF) & !is.na(DenDF) ~ 
          sprintf("F(%s, %.2f) = %.2f, p %s, np2 = %s", NumDF, DenDF, F_val, p_str, Eta_str),
        TRUE ~ "Format not supported"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Effect, APA_Report, F_value = F_val, NumDF, DenDF, p_value = p_val, Eta2_partial)
  
  return(df_res)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper Function: Format Post-hoc tests (with CI)
# ==============================================================================
format_posthoc_apa <- function(emm_df) {
  df_clean <- as.data.frame(emm_df)
  if("t.ratio" %in% names(df_clean)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>%
      mutate(
        p_str = case_when(p.value < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))),
        t_str = sprintf("%.2f", t.ratio), df_str = sprintf("%.2f", df), 
        estimate_col = if("estimate" %in% names(.)) estimate else if("response" %in% names(.)) response else NA,
        estimate_str = sprintf("%.2f", estimate_col), se_str = sprintf("%.2f", SE),
        Stats_String = sprintf("b = %s (SE=%s), t(%s) = %s, p %s", estimate_str, se_str, df_str, t_str, p_str)
      )
  }
  return(df_clean)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper Function: Format Raw Coefficients 
# ==============================================================================
format_coefs <- function(model) {
  tryCatch({
    params <- parameters::model_parameters(model, ci = 0.95, effects = "fixed")
    df_params <- as.data.frame(params)
    
    stat_col <- if("t" %in% names(df_params)) "t" else if("z" %in% names(df_params)) "z" else "Statistic"
    
    df_params %>% mutate(
      p_str = case_when(p < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p))),
      Report = sprintf("b = %.2f, SE = %.2f, %s = %.2f, p %s", Coefficient, SE, stat_col, !!sym(stat_col), p_str)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor")
    return(coef_df)
  })
}
```

``` {r prep-functions}
# ==============================================================================
# Data Loading & Cleaning Functions
# ==============================================================================
standardize_id <- function(ids) sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(str_extract(ids, "\\d+")))

load_covariates <- function(path_cov) {
  if(!file.exists(path_cov)) { warning("Covariate file missing"); return(NULL) }
  cat(sprintf("   [Covariates] Loading: %s\n", basename(path_cov)))
  
  df_cov <- if(grepl("\\.csv$", path_cov)) read_csv(path_cov, show_col_types=FALSE) else read_excel(path_cov)
  names(df_cov)[1] <- "raw_id"
  df_cov$participant_id <- standardize_id(df_cov$raw_id)
  
  if("Rating_1" %in% names(df_cov)) df_cov <- rename(df_cov, Reaction_Score = Rating_1)
  
  df_cov %>% 
    select(participant_id, SVO_angle, SVO_type, Reaction_Score, any_of(c("Antagonism","Detachment","Disinhibition"))) %>%
    mutate(SVO_Z = if("SVO_angle" %in% names(.)) as.numeric(scale(SVO_angle)) else NA_real_)
}

load_and_prep <- function(path_erp, df_covariates, erp_name, baseline_col) {
  if(!file.exists(path_erp)) stop("ERP file missing")
  df <- read_csv(path_erp, show_col_types=FALSE)
  
  if(!(erp_name %in% names(df))) {
    cat(sprintf("   [SKIP] Component '%s' not found in dataset.\n", erp_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df$participant_id <- standardize_id(df$participant_id)
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(Offers_Other %in% c(5, 6, 8, 9)) %>%
    mutate(
      offer_type = factor(case_when(Offers_Other %in% c(5,6)~"fair", Offers_Other %in% c(8,9)~"unfair"), levels = c("fair", "unfair")),
      emotion = factor(emotion, levels = c("neu", "aff", "dis", "dom", "enj"))
    )
  
  orig_n <- nrow(df)
  df <- df %>% filter(abs(!!sym(erp_name)) < 200)
  if(orig_n > nrow(df)) cat(sprintf("   [QC] %s: Dropped %d trials > 200µV\n", erp_name, orig_n-nrow(df)))
  
  if(!is.null(baseline_col) && baseline_col %in% names(df)) {
    df$Baseline_Raw <- df[[baseline_col]]
    df$Baseline_c <- df$Baseline_Raw - mean(df$Baseline_Raw, na.rm=TRUE)
  } else { df$Baseline_c <- 0 }
  
  if(!is.null(df_covariates)) df <- left_join(df, df_covariates, by = "participant_id")
  return(df)
}

check_uniqueness <- function(df, context_name) {
  if(nrow(df) != n_distinct(select(df, participant_id, index))) 
    stop(sprintf("CRITICAL ERROR: Duplicate keys (ID+Index) found in %s", context_name))
}


```

``` {r stats-engine}
# ==============================================================================
# Analytical Engine: Linear Mixed-Effects Modeling
# ==============================================================================
run_regression_analysis <- function(data, erp_name, out_dir, exp_version, use_svo = FALSE) {
  
  sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, erp_name)
  if(!dir.exists(sub_dir)) dir.create(sub_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n>>> Analyzing Component: %s [%s] (N = %d)\n", 
              erp_name, exp_version, n_distinct(data$participant_id)))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Baseline Logic & Fixed Effects Specification
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (exp_version == "E1") {
    baseline_formula <- "+ emotion * Baseline_c" 
  } else if (exp_version == "E2") {
    baseline_formula <- "+ Baseline_c"
  } else {
    stop("Configuration Error: Unknown experiment_version. Must be 'E1' or 'E2'.")
  }

  fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type ", baseline_formula)
  if(use_svo && "SVO_Z" %in% names(data)) {
    cat("   [Config] Including continuous SVO moderation in structural model...\n")
    fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type * SVO_Z ", baseline_formula)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Random Effects Structure Optimization (Data-Driven Maximal Approach)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Methodological definition: Zero-correlation parameterization strategy.
  # Extracts random slopes without associated correlation parameters to prevent
  # singular fits and inappropriate over-penalization of theoretically relevant
  # variance components during backward LRT elimination.
  
  cat("   [Phase 1] Optimizing Random Structure via backward LRT (Zero-Corr)...\n")
  
  # Structural modification based on buildmer optimal practices:
  # Exploding the covariance matrix prevents elimination of slopes due to 
  # unestimable correlation terms.
  random_maximal <- "+ (1 | participant_id) + (0 + emotion | participant_id) + (0 + offer_type | participant_id) + (0 + emotion:offer_type | participant_id)"
  
  f_buildmer <- as.formula(paste(fixed_effects, random_maximal))
  
  bm_res <- buildmer::buildmer(
    formula = f_buildmer, 
    data = data,
    buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
      # Retaining fixed effects during random structure optimization
      include = as.formula(paste("~", str_split(fixed_effects, "~")[[1]][2])),
      direction = c("order", "backward"), 
      crit = "LRT", 
      quiet = TRUE,
      args = list(control = custom_control)
    )
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Final Model Fit & Inferential Statistics
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("   [Phase 2] Fitting final optimized model (REML)...\n")
  final_formula <- formula(bm_res@model)
  
  FINAL_MODEL <- lmer(final_formula, data = data, REML = TRUE, control = custom_control)
  
  formula_str <- paste(deparse(final_formula), collapse = " ")
  cat("\n   [FINAL MODEL FORMULA]:\n   ", str_squish(formula_str), "\n\n")

  anova_res <- anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")
  anova_apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_res)
  print(anova_apa %>% select(Effect, APA_Report))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-hoc Interactions & Simple Effects
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("   [Phase 3] Marginal Means & Post-hoc Contrasts (FDR corrected)...\n")
  
  target_term <- "emotion:offer_type"
  svo_survived <- FALSE
  if(use_svo && any(grepl("SVO_Z", row.names(anova_res)))) {
    target_term <- "emotion:offer_type:SVO_Z"
    svo_survived <- TRUE
  }
  
  p_int <- anova_res[target_term, "Pr(>F)"]
  if(is.na(p_int)) p_int <- 1.0
  
  at_list <- list(Baseline_c = 0)
  if(svo_survived) at_list$SVO_Z <- c(-1, 1) 
  
  list_of_tables <- list(
    "ANOVA_Main" = anova_apa, 
    "Model_Formula" = data.frame(Formula = formula_str), 
    "Model_Coefficients" = format_coefs(FINAL_MODEL)
  )
  
  if (p_int < 0.05) {
    cat("      -> Significant Interaction detected. Decomposing bidirectional simple effects.\n")
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Offer_by_Emotion"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ offer_type | emotion"), at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Emotion_by_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ emotion | offer_type"), at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
  } else {
    cat("      -> No robust interaction detected. Reporting Main Effects.\n")
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type, at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Emotion"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ emotion, at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    
    if (p_int < 0.10) {
      cat("      -> Marginal Interaction detected (p < .10). Adding uncorrected exploratory effects.\n")
      list_of_tables[["Exploratory_Simple_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
        pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ offer_type | emotion"), at = at_list), adjust="none")
      )
    }
  }

  list_of_tables[["Descriptive_Means_SE"]] <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion, at = list(Baseline_c = 0)))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data Export & Visualization
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  for(sheet_name in names(list_of_tables)) {
    safe_sheet_name <- substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", sheet_name), 1, 31)
    addWorksheet(wb, safe_sheet_name)
    writeData(wb, safe_sheet_name, list_of_tables[[sheet_name]])
    addStyle(wb, safe_sheet_name, createStyle(textDecoration="bold", border="Bottom"), rows=1, cols=1:ncol(list_of_tables[[sheet_name]]))
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(sub_dir, paste0("STATS_REPORT_", exp_version, "_", erp_name, ".xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)

  cat("   [Phase 4] Generating diagnostic and interaction plots...\n")
  try({
    p_forest <- sjPlot::plot_model(FINAL_MODEL, type = "est", show.values = TRUE, show.p = TRUE, 
                                   title = paste(exp_version, erp_name, "Coefficients")) + theme_bw()
    ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, paste0("Diag_Forest_Plot_", exp_version, ".png")), p_forest, width = 6, height = 8)
  })

  if(svo_survived) {
      pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion * SVO_Z, at = at_list))
      pd$SVO_Group <- factor(pd$SVO_Z, labels=c("Low SVO (-1SD)", "High SVO (+1SD)"))
      p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
           facet_wrap(~SVO_Group) + geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
           geom_point(size=3, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) +
           labs(title = paste(exp_version, erp_name, "by SVO Moderation"), y = "Amplitude (µV)", x = "Emotion Condition")
  } else {
      pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion, at = list(Baseline_c = 0)))
      p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
           geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
           geom_point(size=3.5, shape=21, fill="white", stroke=2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) + scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_emo) +
           labs(title = paste(exp_version, erp_name, "Interaction Effect"), y = "Amplitude (µV)", x = "Emotion Condition")
  }
  ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, paste0("Plot_", exp_version, "_Main.png")), p_final, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  cat("   >>> Analysis Complete.\n")
}


```

``` {r execution}
# ==============================================================================
# Execution Phase
# ==============================================================================
path_pipeline <- here("data", "02_Pipeline_Output")
path_stim <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
path_resp <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression", "Response_Locked", "trials.csv")

path_cov_csv <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Covariates", "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.csv")
path_cov_xlsx <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Covariates", "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.xlsx")
path_cov <- if(file.exists(path_cov_csv)) path_cov_csv else path_cov_xlsx

if(!file.exists(path_stim)) stop("Stimulus file not found. Have you run the upstream preprocessing script?")

cat("--- Loading Covariates ---\n")
df_covs <- load_covariates(path_cov)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stimulus-Locked Analysis (Dynamic Loop)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(file.exists(path_stim)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Stimulus-Locked Components ===\n")
  
  for (comp_name in names(analyze_stim_components)) {
    use_cov <- as.logical(analyze_stim_components[comp_name])
    baseline_col_name <- paste0("Baseline_", comp_name)
    
    df_comp <- load_and_prep(path_stim, df_covs, comp_name, baseline_col_name)
    
    if (!is.null(df_comp)) {
      run_regression_analysis(df_comp, comp_name, out_root, experiment_version, use_svo = use_cov)
    }
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Response-Locked Analysis (Dynamic Loop)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(file.exists(path_resp) && file.exists(path_stim)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Response-Locked Components ===\n")
  
  df_stim_base <- read_csv(path_stim, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = ifelse(grepl("^\\d+$", as.character(participant_id)), 
                                   sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(participant_id)), as.character(participant_id)))
  
  for (comp_name in names(analyze_resp_components)) {
    use_cov <- as.logical(analyze_resp_components[comp_name])
    df_comp_raw <- load_and_prep(path_resp, df_covs, comp_name, NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(df_comp_raw)) {
      check_uniqueness(df_comp_raw, comp_name); check_uniqueness(df_stim_base, "Base")
      
      df_comp_merged <- left_join(df_comp_raw, df_stim_base %>% select(participant_id, index, Baseline_LPP_offer), by = c("participant_id", "index"))
      if(sum(is.na(df_comp_merged$Baseline_LPP_offer)) > 0) warning(sprintf("%s: Missing baseline matches.", comp_name))
      
      df_comp_merged$Baseline_Raw <- df_comp_merged$Baseline_LPP_offer
      df_comp_merged$Baseline_c <- as.numeric(scale(df_comp_merged$Baseline_Raw, center=TRUE, scale=FALSE))
      
      run_regression_analysis(df_comp_merged %>% filter(!is.na(Baseline_c)), comp_name, out_root, experiment_version, use_svo = use_cov)
    }
  }
}

cat(sprintf("\n========================================\n   %s Master Analysis Pipeline Completed.\n========================================\n", experiment_version))
```
